title: Vegetarian Naan Sandwich
subtitle: with Tofu, Carrot and Cucumber
description: We've filled soft, fluffy naan bread with warm tofu, veggie ribbons and mild Indian spices for a lip-smacking dinner-style sandwich.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Roughly chop 30g butter, put in a bowl and set aside to soften. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Cut the tofu into 1.5cm chunks. Thinly slice the onion. Peel the carrot, then peel the carrot and cucumber into ribbons with a vegetable peeler.

Roast tofu and onion: Add the garlic and 1 tsp masala seasoning to the butter, season with salt and pepper and mash with a fork until well combined. Put the tofu and half the onion on the lined tray. Dot half the masala butter over the top and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 10 mins or until the onion is golden and tender and the tofu is warmed through.

Warm naan: Meanwhile, spread the remaining masala butter over one side of each naan. Sandwich the naan together, with the buttered sides facing in. Wrap in foil and bake for 8 mins or until warmed through.

Assemble sandwiches: Put ¼ tsp masala seasoning and 2 tbs mayonnaise in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Spread the buttered sides of the warm naan with three-quarters of the masala mayonnaise, then halve widthwise. Top the bases with the tofu and onion mixture, half the carrot and half the cucumber. Sandwich with the naan tops.

Serve up: Add ½ tsp water to the remaining masala mayonnaise and stir to combine. Add the remaining carrot, remaining cucumber and remaining onion and toss to coat (see Make it yours). Divide the naan sandwiches among plates, serve with the carrot and cucumber salad and enjoy!
Make it yours: Like it crunchy? Chop up some roasted salted peanuts and scatter over the salad before serving.
